name: Randoncorp S.A.
summary: Randoncorp S.A. manufactures and sells trailers and semi-trailers, and auto parts in Latin America and internationally. The company offers bodies, trailers, semi-trailers, and railcars; auto parts, including axles and suspensions to truck, bus, and implement manufacturers; truck, bus, trailer and semi-trailer brakes; commercial vehicle coupling components and systems; and hub and drum assemblies and cast steel brackets for the axles and suspensions of buses, trucks, trailers, farm machines, and tractors, as well as wheel end system solutions.
